Crafting Landmarks

A Legacy Built on Trust & Vision

For 40 years, Vaswani Group has shaped skylines and redefined luxury, transforming aspirations into tangible realities across Bangalore and beyond.

Leadership that Inspires

Driving innovation and excellence in Luxury Real Estate market with decades of unparalleled expertise.

Accolades of Excellence

Best Luxury Residential Project South Zone

Precision in Every Detail

In 1985, we embarked on a journey to offer global-standard residential solutions for the discerning home buyer as well as turnkey commercial solutions for Indian & multinational firms.

Our equity is strengthened with a proven and credible track record having developed close to 8 million square feet of built up area in the verticals of Residential, Commercial, Retail and Hospitality.

We are committed to constantly refining our skills with an ever present emphasis on transparency.
